definitions.explanation: The digestive organ consisting of the small and large intestines. Used in medical, health, and everyday contexts.

examples.japanese: {腸|ちょう}の{調子|ちょうし}が{悪|わる}い。
ヨーグルトは{腸内環境|ちょうないかんきょう}を{整|ととの}えるのにいい。
examples.english: Yogurt is good for improving your gut environment.

examples.japanese: {医師|いし}から{大腸|だいちょう}の{検査|けんさ}を{受|う}けるように{勧|すす}められた。
examples.english: The doctor recommended that I get a colon examination.

notes:
The general term for intestines. Appears in many medical and health-related compounds. Gut health ({腸活|ちょうかつ}) has become a popular wellness topic in Japan.

COMPOUNDS:
- {大腸|だいちょう} — large intestine, colon
- {小腸|しょうちょう} — small intestine
- {腸内|ちょうない} — intestinal, inside the gut
- {腸内環境|ちょうないかんきょう} — gut environment/flora
- {腸炎|ちょうえん} — enteritis, intestinal inflammation
- {盲腸|もうちょう} — appendix; appendicitis (colloquial)
- {腸活|ちょうかつ} — gut health activities
- {胃腸|いちょう} — stomach and intestines, gastrointestinal

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腸|ちょう}の{調子|ちょうし} — intestinal condition
- {腸|ちょう}を{整|ととの}える — to regulate the intestines
- {腸|ちょう}が{弱|よわ}い — to have a weak stomach/gut

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {胃|い} — stomach (upper digestive organ)
- {腹|はら} — belly, abdomen (more colloquial for the whole area)
- はらわた — guts, entrails (more visceral/literary)
